snippet.title: Project Solaris - Play Movie 60s
snippet.description:
Project Solaris Play Movie
[Project Solaris] is a scenario-driven roguelite RPG in which "Solaris", a less magic mage, aims to become a full-fledged mage with her little sidekick, "Homu". Train Homu, build a relationship of trust, and overcome the trials that await you in 100 days!
